docChanges.newValue: Vue Dashboard queue/march sources, countdown lifecycle, and evidence-based daily activity completion and reset rules.

## Sources and rendering

Implemented by @task-VHE-64GPHS.

- `src/utils/dashboardState.ts::dashboardQueues` reads canonical `buildingStatus.data.queues` and `researchStatus.data.queues`, with legacy queue cache fallbacks. Show every observed upgrade, metadata names, target levels and active/ready timing. Epoch seconds are converted to milliseconds; explicit `durationMs` takes precedence over legacy seconds. Missing snapshots are unknown; observed empty queues are idle. Elapsed upgrades remain Ready until the authoritative cache removes them.
- `dashboardMarches` uses normalized `marchStatus.data.marches`, existing `getMarchBadgeInfo` and `isMarchExpired`. Keep battle, rally wait, gathering and outbound entries awaiting authoritative updates; remove returns when their normalized `endsAt` expires. Show phase/countdowns and existing detailed squad tooltips; link raid, gather and monster entries to their dialogs.
- `QueuesOverview.vue` and `ActivityGoals.vue` use `useNow` so countdowns and daily freshness react while mounted/active and stop while deactivated/unmounted. Cache changes remain reactive through `useRpcCache`.
- Dashboard Refresh All requests summaries, marches, Tower, Arena, `userGetInfo` (Arena refillable amounts), world refillables with their feature, Dungeon/titan roster, Hydra and quest/reset snapshots through the existing shared RPC dispatch policy.

## Daily states

`src/composables/activityState.ts` owns the Tower, Arena and Dungeon models.

- A completion observation must be fresh. Use the observed server daily reset `questResetStatus.data.nextDayAt` when present; fall back to the local calendar convention used by existing reducers. Missing dates, old observations and future observations cannot prove today's completion.
- Tower: a fresh canonical cleared status, completed session or brief win/completed state is Done. The newest snapshot wins over an older completed session. No current evidence is Unknown.
- Arena and Grand Arena: fresh nonnegative integer amounts from `resource:refillable:6` and `resource:refillable:21` respectively. Zero is Done; positive is Pending; missing/stale/invalid values are Unknown. Rank is independent of attempt availability.
- Dungeon: require fresh status, evidence of today's combat (`dailyCombatLog` with today's date and a positive battle count, or a current `dungeonEndBattle` result), known next-floor doors and no active battle. Done requires every next door's eligible owned titans to be explicitly dead (`isDead` or numeric nonpositive HP). Examine all owned titans using packaged element metadata, rather than a saved team/automation pool. Missing HP/roster/metadata or unsupported doors cannot prove exhaustion. An alternate door or surviving eligible titan keeps Pending. Missing next doors is Unknown.
- Hydra: fresh, valid regular/super attempt counters are Done only when both are exhausted. Missing/stale counters are Unknown.
- Daily quests distinguish current claimable rewards and in-progress daily work from missing snapshots; absence of a reward does not by itself prove all daily quests completed.

## Verification

`tests/dashboard-state.test.mjs` exercises time units, active/ready/idle/unknown queues, object-shaped collections, march lifecycle, completion evidence, alternate Dungeon doors/remaining titans, missing observations, daily reset and reactive execution of the actual Dashboard SFC setup code. Existing `vue-ui-parity-runtime.test.mjs` covers brief-only Tower state with dated observations. Live Chrome/game visual acceptance remains separate from these automated setup tests.

## Daily states

`src/composables/activityState.ts` owns the Tower, Arena and Dungeon models.

- A completion observation must be fresh. Use the observed server daily reset `questResetStatus.data.nextDayAt` when present; fall back to the local calendar convention used by existing reducers. Missing dates, old observations and future observations cannot prove today's completion.
- Tower: a fresh canonical cleared status, completed session or brief win/completed state is Done. The newest snapshot wins over an older completed session. No current evidence is Unknown.
- Arena and Grand Arena: fresh nonnegative integer amounts from `resource:refillable:6` and `resource:refillable:21` respectively. Zero is Done; positive is Pending; missing/stale/invalid values are Unknown. Rank is independent of attempt availability.
- Dungeon: require fresh status, evidence of today's combat (`dailyCombatLog` with today's date and a positive battle count, or a current `dungeonEndBattle` result), known next-floor doors and no active battle. Done requires every next door's eligible owned titans to be explicitly dead (`isDead` or numeric nonpositive HP). Examine all owned titans using packaged element metadata, rather than a saved team/automation pool. Missing HP/roster/metadata or unsupported doors cannot prove exhaustion. An alternate door or surviving eligible titan keeps Pending. Missing next doors is Unknown.
- Hydra: fresh, valid regular/super attempt counters are Done only when both are exhausted. Missing/stale counters are Unknown.
- Daily quests distinguish current claimable rewards and in-progress daily work from missing snapshots; absence of a reward does not by itself prove all daily quests completed.

## Verification

`tests/dashboard-state.test.mjs` exercises time units, active/ready/idle/unknown queues, object-shaped collections, march lifecycle, completion evidence, alternate Dungeon doors/remaining titans, missing observations, daily reset and reactive execution of the actual Dashboard SFC setup code. Existing `vue-ui-parity-runtime.test.mjs` covers brief-only Tower state with dated observations. Live Chrome/game visual acceptance remains separate from these automated setup tests.

## Final boss completion (VHE-01ZJZ6)

An accepted `magicTower_endBattle` with `args.result.win === true` while the current room is `boss_battle` immediately sets canonical towerSession.completed and towerStatus.isCleared, even without optional magicTower_completion / magicTower_briefInfo sidecars. Failed or missing RPC responses, boss losses and regular hero_battle wins do not count. The reducer retains roomType on combat history. Dashboard also recognizes an existing current-floor boss victory in session history (array or object map), checking its observation date when provided, so previously cached runs display Done without replaying a battle. Merely reaching floor 23 is not completion evidence. A newer reset/run and the server daily reset retain precedence.

Regression coverage: tests/tower-session.test.mjs and tests/dashboard-state.test.mjs; full suite 614 tests, 602 passed, 12 optional private-data skips, zero failures. Typecheck/build validated.


## Tower denominator from splitlib (2026-11-13)

The Tower progress denominator comes from shared generated `hwaHelperTowerRules.floorCount`, currently 23. Floor number alone never proves completion, including an unexpected floor above the configured count. The fallback boss-win history must belong to the configured final floor. Source and refresh instructions: @doc/architecture/tower-floor-count-from-splitlib.


## Expeditions and completed Tower snapshots (2026-11-14)

@task-VHE-03VDQ4 adds the Expeditions card to Activities, with aggregate progress and a timer/auto-start dialog. Canonical contract and verified VIP/subscription/hero rules: @doc/api/expedition-rpc-contract-and-dashboard-automation.

Tower `magicTower_getAll` can represent completion without any top-level `state`: the observed `floorData.floorNumber=23` contains a `boss_battle` room with `state=room_completed`. Earlier reduction converted that snapshot into `inProgress/isCleared=false`, overwriting a successful brief snapshot or session. Extraction now treats an explicitly completed boss room on the configured final floor as completion. The Activity view also recognizes that evidence in existing cached floorData/session rooms, so replay is not required. Standing on the final floor, an initial boss room or a completed ordinary room is insufficient. Freshness and a newer reset/new-run snapshot retain precedence. Tests in `tests/expeditions.test.mjs` cover getAll alone, both brief/getAll orders, legacy caches and negative/reset/day cases.


## Explicit Energy and World Energy refresh (0.10.92)

@task-VHE-WZJWZX keeps the existing verified resource sources but prioritizes them in Dashboard Refresh All: its first dispatch is userGetInfo plus refillableGetAll with feature refillable. These calls were already present in the broad batch; they now have a dedicated first request and are removed from the remaining snapshot list. Piggyback may still coalesce queued reads onto a native carrier under the existing shared RPC policy; no dispatch mode is bypassed.

The button disables during dispatch and without a game tab, ignores overlapping clicks and reports queued/transport failures. Acknowledgement means requested, not refreshed. Canonical Energy from userGetInfo refillable1 and World Energy from refillableGetAll refillableId2 update ResourceSummary and Header only through actual RPC cache reduction. No balance or refill timestamp is synthesized by the click.

Verification: tests/dashboard-energy-refresh.test.mjs executes the actual Dashboard and ResourceSummary setup, proves both reads are requested first, queued ack leaves old values untouched, authoritative replies update Energy120 and World Energy90, and disabled RPC/overlapping clicks do not dispatch extra reads. Full820 tests:808 passed,12 optional private-log skips; typecheck/build passed.
